result:
Round 37 (TM-B39, D-44) passes all six acceptance checks, and the real app was tested (realVerified=true). The fix works: after a folder load, the selection only keeps files that are in the new list. I did not change any source; the source fingerprint was the same at the start and end of my phase.

**Before vs after in the real app** (Electron under xvfb, driven through the UI, with each folder scan delayed by 4 s; old build `51969a2`, new build A's tree):

| Scenario | Old build | New build |
|---|---|---|
| S1: click a row of `/fa` while `/fb` is loading | `1 selected · 1 files`, no highlighted row (the bug) | no `selected` text, no highlighted row |
| S2: Rescan after `a.wav` was deleted, `a.wav` + Ctrl `a2.wav` clicked | `2 selected` with one highlighted row | `a2.wav` highlighted, `1 selected · 1 files`, form shows its title `PreA2Title` |
| S3: type into a row, then the new folder finishes loading | no toast, `1 selected` | toast `Unsaved changes were discarded`, empty editor |
| S4: Shift-click after a Rescan where the anchor row survives | range a2–a4 | range a2–a4 |

- **Save (S2, new build):** Category `R37Kept` was saved to `a2.wav`. Both ffprobe and music-metadata read `ICAT=R37Kept` and the title `PreA2Title`, matching the form. I compared only those two fields; the file also gets an empty `IKEY`.
- **Files and errors:** no other file changed (sha256), and none of the 10 runs had page or console errors.

**Gate and tests:**
- **Gate:** the full `verifyCommand` from a clean state exited 0: Biome 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as round 35, type check clean, renderer 296/296, main 93/93, E2E 7/7. E2E with `--retries=0` is also 7/7.
- **Red → green:** the new test file fails 7/7 on the old store code, with the stale-selection symptom. With the fix it passes 7/7, slowest test 195 ms. The full renderer suite passed twice, and each of the 19 files passes alone.
- **Mutants:** all four required ones fail the tests as the task expects. I added two of my own: "clear instead of prune" is also caught, but "prune in file order" survives (see C-R37-01).
- **Ownership:** only the four owned paths changed. The store change matches B's prototype line for line, and the test file is identical to B's.
- **Docs:** entry 20 is appended and entries 1–19 are unchanged. Every `file:line` reference points at the right code, and each test name appears once. The README count 20 / 11 / 5 matches my recount. The Qt, Kid3 and Mp3tag sources say what the entry claims.

**Two low findings (they don't affect the PASS):**
- **C-R37-01:** no test checks that the pruned selection keeps its original order. It makes no visible difference today: the order only matters when one file is selected, and save compares selections as sets.
- **C-R37-02:** the header of `docs/bugs/001` (lines 3–22) still stops at entry 18 and decision D-43. The task froze those lines, so this is B's follow-up, not a fault in A's work (A reported it as A-R37-01).

**Two deviations from the task text:**
- **Scan delay:** the named `c-round-33/harness.cjs` only delays paths ending in `/fast`. I wrote my own harness that delays any scan once armed. I armed it only after the first `/fa` load, and the logs show only the target scan was delayed.
- **Pre-tagged run (S2p):** the fixture WAV has no tags, so in plain S2 "the form shows `a2.wav`'s values" looked the same as an empty form. I added this variant where `a2.wav` already has a title before the Rescan.
